| `strategy_cooldown_bars` | 3 | 3 fixed | Completed D1 bars blocked after every owned exit |

## 7. Risk Model

| Phase | Risk mode | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Backtest (Q02 – Q10) | RISK_FIXED | $1,000 per trade (HR4) |
| Live burn-in (Q13) | RISK_PERCENT | Min-lot equivalent |
| Full live (post-Q13 PASS) | RISK_PERCENT | Allocated by Q11 portfolio (typically 0.3% – 0.5%) |

Backtest setfiles bind `RISK_FIXED=1000` and `RISK_PERCENT=0`. Live packaging,
if separately authorized after the pipeline and deploy gates, must invert that
contract (`RISK_FIXED=0`, OWNER-approved `RISK_PERCENT`). Framework validation
is enforced by `QM_FrameworkInit` / build conformance checks.
